sections.title: I Introduction
sections.extract: QCD is the accepted underlying theory of the strong interactions, and the properties of the spectrum and in- teractions of hadrons should be calculable from it using a suitable regularization scheme for the quark and gluon ﬁelds. sections.title: VI Effects of finite temporal extent
sections.extract: EXTENT Our extractions of ﬁnite-volume ππ energy spectra fol- low from analysis of the time-dependence of correlation functions and the form of these time-dependencies is af- fected by the ﬁnite temporal extent of the lattice. The size of ﬁnite-T eﬀects are generically determined by the size of e−mπT , which while small on these lattices, is large enough for its eﬀects to be visible, particularly in the ππ sector.
